(2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of a white wooden sideboard acting as a charging station. A pink foldable smartphone, a tablet, a smartwatch, and a white handheld vacuum are scattered amongst tangled white charging cables connected to a central white rectangular charging hub. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The camera returns to the woman, who holds a white Jway charging device in her right hand while pointing at it with her left index finger. She maintains direct eye contact with the lens and looks excited. The setting remains the indoor kitchen with white cabinetry. Several white USB-C and USB-A cables are plugged into the ports. The plastic texture of the device is smooth and well-defined under the studio lighting. Her facial expression is animated, and her hands move dynamically to emphasize her points. A yellow cartoon lightning bolt icon appears as an overlay. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the glossy screens of the electronic devices on the wooden surface. (7) The frame displays the product's white retail packaging alongside several international power adapters including US, EU, and UK styles. A hand enters the frame to pick up the UK adapter, showing its three-pin design. The brand name 'Jway' is clearly visible on the box. (8) A static screen capture of a mobile Instagram profile for 'peri168' is shown. A large red arrow points to a specific URL in the biography section. The interface includes typical social media elements like follower counts and a thumbnail grid.
